title: The “exam leak” closes at midnight
scenario: A class group chat suddenly shares a site claiming to have tomorrow’s exam questions. Access costs $8 and the page says the file disappears at midnight. Several classmates are debating whether to buy it.

answers.A: Ask a trusted classmate whether the school has warned about fake exam links before doing anything.
answers.B: Open the preview only, without paying, to see whether the questions look real.
answers.C: Do not pay or download it; tell a trusted teacher or school staff member that the link is circulating.

explanation: Exam-leak bait can deliver malware, steal payment details, or create discipline problems even if the file is fake.
proTip: If the “advantage” requires a risky link, the cost can be bigger than the exam.
